I propose 10 tons each this month: 25 × 10 = 250 caught, leaving 250, so next month returns to 500 under either replenishment outcome. That yields $10,000 each per month indefinitely if maintained. Larger requests risk exhausting the lake and ending everyone's future income. I intend to request 10 and invite all fishers to do the same.
